senses.gloss: † विथ् विथ्, वेथ् वेथ्, विध् विध्, i. 1, Ātm. To beg.

विथुर विथुर,
 I. probably व्यथ् + उर, adj. Trembling, Chr. 293, 3 = Rigv. i. 87, 3.
 II. m.
 1. A Rākṣasa.
 2. A thief.
 --Comp.

वीथि and वीथी वीथी̆, probably वि-इ + थ + ई, f.
 1. A line, MBh. 13, 5261.
 2. A road, Pañc. i. d. 189; Indr. 2, 12.
 3. A stall, a shop, Śiś. 9, 32.
 4. A terrace in front of a house.
 5. A sort of drama.
 --Comp.
वीथिका वीथि + का, f. A hall, Utt. Rāmac. 9, 13.
